senses.gloss: f., pl. בּוֹרָאוֹת, בּוֹרָייוֹת (בּוּר I) trees which fail to thrive after transplantation.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 95a:6">B. Bath. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>מקבל עליו עשר ב׳ למאה</he> Ms. H. a. Ar. (ed. <he>בורייות</he>, <he>בוריות</he>, Ms. M. <he>טראות לסאה</he> corr. acc.) the owner must be prepared for ten failures out of one hundred trees planted (and has no claim on the contractor).
